# Surefire shards for the Build workflow (issue #54).
#
# Format: <shard-id> <comma-separated Surefire -Dtest patterns>
# Patterns match the simple class name; only letters, digits, '_' and '*' are allowed.
#
# Shards are contiguous first-letter ranges of the test class name, so every class that
# starts with an upper-case A-Z letter is covered by construction. The ranges were balanced
# with per-class times from the last single-job CI run (8,992 s of class time in total):
#   1  A     ~1,850 s  (includes AuthorizationEntryGuardTest, the slowest class at ~460 s)
#   2  B-F   ~1,270 s
#   3  G-L   ~1,510 s
#   4  M-P   ~1,830 s
#   5  Q-R   ~1,580 s
#   6  S-Z     ~960 s
#
# .github/scripts/test-shards.py check fails the workflow when a test class matches no shard
# or more than one shard. Rebalance here when a range grows much slower than the others.
1 A*Test
2 B*Test,C*Test,D*Test,E*Test,F*Test
3 G*Test,H*Test,I*Test,J*Test,K*Test,L*Test
4 M*Test,N*Test,O*Test,P*Test
5 Q*Test,R*Test
6 S*Test,T*Test,U*Test,V*Test,W*Test,X*Test,Y*Test,Z*Test
